title: MOCA Sidecar Index Manifest Schema
description: JSON Schema for index.json in a MOCA .moca.idx sidecar archive.

target_package_id.description: Identifier of the target MOCA package.

target_package_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 digest of the target .moca archive. Consumers SHOULD verify a declared digest before use.

index_type.description: Retrieval characteristics, such as dense_vector, hybrid_vector_bm25, or sparse_bm25_only.

chunking.description: Optional chunking strategy metadata used during index generation.

item_addressing.description: Declares the required logical fields carried by every indexed item in the storage payload.

content_path.description: Canonical path relative to the target package's content/ directory.

chunk_index.description: Zero-based position of the indexed item within its content path.

chunk_count.description: Positive total number of indexed items for its content path.

format.description: Open identifier for the payload format, such as sqlite-vec, jsonl, lance, or parquet.

file.description: Relative path to the storage-native payload within the sidecar archive.

^x-[a-zA-Z0-9]+-.description: Vendor extension keys, namespaced as x-<vendor>-<key>.
